editorial:
Imagine heading home for the holidays only to realize your boyfriend is about to dump you right before the big dinner. That is exactly what Lucy is facing in this cute little flick. She is a college freshman who used to be the quiet, safe girl in town, but she has changed a lot since leaving for school. When she smells a breakup coming, she decides she is not going to just sit back and take it. The vibe is super cozy and light, making it a perfect pick for when you just want to relax and feel good.

You will love how Lucy finds her confidence and stops trying to please everyone. The acting is natural, and the pacing keeps things moving so you never get bored. While it is a simple story, it hits all the right notes for a holiday romance. If you are in the mood for something sweet, you should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. You could also rent it on Apple TV if you want a quick movie night with friends or family.
endingExplained: By the end, Lucy realizes that her high school sweetheart is not the right match for her new, confident self. Instead of begging him to stay, she chooses her own happiness and growth. She finds a deeper connection with someone who actually appreciates who she has become. The movie wraps up with a heartwarming Thanksgiving where Lucy feels proud of herself and finally lets go of her past to start a fresh chapter.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves sweet holiday rom-coms and stories about finding yourself.
